name: W2U Apparel
old_description: Branding Businesses, Organizations and Individuals Through Apparel and Promotional Products.
about:
W2U Apparel operates from Salem, Oregon, where it has occupied a dedicated shop since 2018. The business was founded in 2010, beginning at a kitchen table before moving to a print table as demand grew. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the company describes its origins as a necessity-driven venture that expanded from a home workspace.

The company provides custom screen printing, embroidery, and graphic design services, producing decorated apparel and promotional items for clients. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include businesses seeking branded merchandise, schools such as Sprague High School, sports teams ordering custom jerseys and caps, and individuals commemorating events like senior nights. The firm also produces sublimated business cards and other promotional gear.

W2U Apparel emphasizes fast turnarounds, responsive service, and a hands-on approach that it describes as bordering on obsessive. The shop’s personality is reflected in its resident dog Remmy and cat Tito, which the company highlights as part of its culture.

name: WB COMPONENTS LLC
old_description: Simply fill out and submit the form below to send us an email.
about:
Based in Edgeley, North Dakota, WB Components LLC has over 40 years of experience in the truss industry. The company operates from a facility on the Willowbank Hutterite Colony, where craftsmen build roof and floor trusses, engineered wood products, columns, and hangers.

The plant uses automated tables and high-tech saws to produce trusses up to 112 feet wide and floor trusses spanning up to 40 feet. Described as one of the largest truss plants in the upper Midwest, the facility maintains stock trusses for quick delivery and employs senior designers who handle complex commercial projects.

WB Components serves residential builders, agricultural storage operators, commercial contractors, and livestock facilities including dairy, hog confinement, and turkey barns. Its product line covers roof trusses for spans up to 112 feet, engineered columns, and a range of hangers.

The company emphasizes its combination of advanced technology and hands-on craftsmanship, noting that its trusses are built by colony craftsmen using the newest design, saw, and table technology.

name: WB Manufacturing (formerly Wisconsin Bench)
old_description: Our new Lookbook brings together inspiring environments and solutions designed to support how students learn today.
about:
WB Manufacturing, headquartered in Thorp, Wisconsin, operates as a manufacturer of furniture and architectural casework for educational and commercial settings. The company, formerly known as Wisconsin Bench, provides design, fabrication, and delivery services from its Thorp facility.

The product line includes standard cabinets and lockers, modular casework, mobile furniture, and custom solutions tailored to specific spaces. An in-house design team works with CET design software to render rooms and integrate product specifications. The company also offers a Build & Hold program for project staging, project registration, and continuing education credit (CEU) opportunities for design professionals.

Recent projects include Paso Verde STEAM School in Sacramento, California, and Tomahawk Elementary in the Shawnee Mission School District. The company also markets its capabilities to broader commercial markets, emphasizing flexibility for any environment.

The company positions its in‑house design team and ability to handle both fixed and mobile installations as key differentiators. Its Build & Hold program allows customers to stage deliveries to match construction schedules, and the design team can import room dimensions directly into CET to furnish spaces virtually. WB Manufacturing emphasizes a "Design. Build. Deliver." approach, aiming to provide end‑to‑end service from concept through installation.

name: WCP Solutions
old_description: Call today to speak with our customer service team, sign up for an account, and learn about our products, services, and equipment solutions.
about:
WCP Solutions traces its roots to March 1, 1930, when the company began operating out of a Ford Model A in Seattle’s Pike Place Market and International District. Now a third-generation, privately owned wholesale distributor, the business serves the Pacific Northwest and beyond from multiple divisions, including the Idaho Falls location managed by division manager Brad Bolander. The Idaho Falls division covers eastern Idaho, northern Utah, and western Wyoming from its warehouse

The company distributes paper and envelopes, packaging and shipping supplies, facility and janitorial products, food-service disposables, and personal protective equipment. It also sells, integrates, and services janitorial and packaging equipment. An in-house converting and manufacturing team produces Perfect Fit® custom sheets, prototypes, and envelopes, while local warehouses and a fleet of yellow delivery trucks support next-day service across the region.

Customers range from commercial printers and creative agencies to restaurants, food processors, healthcare facilities, universities, and grocery retailers. Long-term accounts include Idahoan Foods in Idaho Falls, Kent’s Meats & Groceries in Redding, A.T. Publishing & Printing in Anchorage, the University of Oregon in Eugene, Capitol City Press in Tumwater, and Rogue Valley Medical Center in Medford.

WCP emphasizes locally based support that spans consulting, sourcing, stocking, and delivery, backed by online ordering tools. The company’s WCP Cares program directs each division to partner with a local nonprofit; the Idaho Falls division supports the 1614 Revival Foundation, a refuge for survivors of domestic violence. Sustainability initiatives include recycling all paper waste by grade, reusing wood pallets and plastic packaging, and operating a fleet that meets CARB standards with electric material-handling equipment in warehouses.

name: WIREONE Electric - Des Moines
old_description: , our team of electricians in Des Moines are the highest trained in the area.
about:
WIREONE Electric operates from Pleasant Hill, Iowa, serving Greater Des Moines and Central Iowa through seven regional offices. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides residential and commercial electrical services including wiring, lighting installation, electrical panel and breaker work, surge protection, outlet and switch installation, smart home technology integration, safety inspections, rewiring, ceiling fan installation, and EV charging station installation. Technicians operate from a mobile warehouse stocked with thousands of parts, enabling most jobs to be completed in a single visit. The team completes over 200 hours of continuing education annually, well above the 18-hour requirement.

Customers include homeowners, businesses, and real estate professionals across Iowa and Illinois communities such as Ankeny, Cedar Rapids, Davenport, and Moline. The company’s blog addresses commercial electrical safety inspections, home buyer and seller inspections, and Midwest weather preparedness.

WIREONE emphasizes 24/7 availability with same-day service, upfront pricing with financing options, and a five-year warranty included on every service at no extra cost. The company was built on a “1 Visit & Done” model, aiming to resolve issues on the first appointment.

name: WTN Electronics, Ltd.
old_description: Your responsive, resourceful, and reliable supplier since 1984
about:
WTN Electronics, Ltd. was established in 1984 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, originally under the name World Trade Network, Ltd. The company is led by President John Kyriagis and has operated as a wholesale and retail supplier of marine electronics, marine safety equipment, instruments, and spare parts for more than 35 years.

The firm sources products from a network of U.S.-based manufacturers and offers a single-source procurement service for customers in over 45 countries. Orders are processed and inspected according to an ISO 9001 quality system, and many items ship from stock or within a few days of order receipt.

WTN serves the marine industry broadly, supplying commercial and recreational vessel operators, shipyards, and marine contractors with electronics, safety gear, instrumentation, and replacement parts. The company handles both wholesale and retail transactions, and its product line card covers a wide range of marine equipment categories.

The company’s stated mission emphasizes responsive, resourceful, and reliable service: all customer inquiries receive a response within 24 hours, and the team leverages its long experience to locate and supply virtually any U.S.-made product a client requires.

name: WV Supply
old_description: WV Supply helps customers get work done profitably with responsive local support, dependable delivery, and access to the products and services that keep projects moving.
about:
WV Supply operates from its headquarters in Marietta, Ohio, and serves customers across West Virginia, Kentucky, and Ohio through eight branch locations. With over 90 years of experience in electrical distribution, the company has built a regional footprint that supports contractors, industrial operations, facilities, and project teams.

As a full-line electrical distributor, WV Supply stocks more than 20,000 products and represents over 160 manufacturers across core categories that include builder’s products, conduit and fittings, electrical distribution and management, enclosures, hardware, lighting, tools, wire and cable, and wiring devices. Beyond inventory, the company provides a suite of field-focused services: routine and jobsite delivery, 24/7 emergency support, pre-staged deliveries organized by project phase or area, on-site trailer service for immediate crew access, vendor-managed inventory programs, and specialized wire services such as custom cutting, pulling heads, paralleling, color phasing, and staged identification for wire ranging from 20 AWG to 750 MCM. Account tools include credit services, BillPay, ePOD, job-account structures, tax-exempt processing, and ANSI X12 EDI integration.

The customer base spans commercial, institutional, and general construction projects, as well as industrial maintenance and facility operations. Electrical contractors, plant managers, and project superintendents rely on the distributor for product availability, rapid response, and logistical support that keeps work on schedule.

WV Supply’s stated mission is to help customers get their work done profitably. The company emphasizes three commitments — making it happen when conditions change, acting immediately through local teams, and delivering when it matters — guided by values of integrity, excellence, and customer value.

name: Wabash Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Wabash Plastics can help you bring production back to the USA
about:
Wabash Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1973 in Evansville, Indiana, a city on the border between the Midwest and the South. The company began as an injection molder producing parts for its sister company, Cresline Plastic Pipe Co., before expanding to serve other original equipment manufacturers. Today it operates as part of a family of plastics companies headquartered in Evansville.

The company specializes in custom injection molded components and assemblies, running more than 58 injection molding machines, many configured for two-shot and multi-shot production. Its process portfolio includes gas-assist molding, insert molding, stack molding, fan and blower molding with balancing, and in-mold labeling and applique. In-house decoration capabilities cover pad printing, hot stamping, heat transfer, roll-on hot stamping, and part marking. Assembly services range from custom cells and robotic cobots to ultrasonic, vibration, spin, infrared, and hot-plate welding, plus foam-in-place gaskets and leak testing.

Wabash serves appliance, automotive, HVAC, point-of-purchase, and consumer-goods OEMs across North America. The company emphasizes reshoring and nearshoring, positioning its Midwest location as a way to shorten supply chains and improve oversight.

Wabash cites its ISO 9001:2015 certification and a history of supplier performance awards as evidence of its focus on cost competitiveness, quality, and on-time project launches. The firm says it measures results by shortening design cycles, lowering production costs, and improving product quality.

Wanderlust Apparel Co. operates as Wanderlust Apparel Boutique from Searcy, Arkansas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The boutique stocks a range of women's apparel including waffle-knit shorts and tops, crewnecks, graphic tees, and socks under labels such as LULU MAC and LULU MAX. It also carries novelty squishy toys, stress-relief items, soy-wax candles, tanning products, and household cleaning products under the BOUJEE and PETA JANE brands. A dedicated school-spirit section offers custom-printed tees, crewnecks, and mocknecks for the Searcy Lions and BK Bulldogs programs. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The business serves individual consumers shopping for boutique clothing, giftable novelties, self-care items, and local team merchandise. Its online store ships orders over $150 free of charge.

The company does not state a founding mission or point of differentiation on its site.
